### CVE-2018-6961
- Assigner: vmware | Published: 2018-06-11 | Updated: 2025-10-21 | Max CVSS: 8.1
- CWE: Command Injection; CWE-78 CWE-78 Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 8.1 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=active, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total
- **CISA KEV**: added 2022-03-25, ransomware=Unknown — VMware SD-WAN Edge by VeloCloud Command Injection Vulnerability
- Exploit-DB 44959: VMware NSX SD-WAN Edge < 3.1.2 - Command Injection (webapps/hardware, 2018-07-02, verified=1)

VMware NSX SD-WAN Edge by VeloCloud prior to version 3.1.0 contains a command injection vulnerability in the local web UI component. This component is disabled by default and should not be enabled on untrusted networks. VeloCloud by VMware will be removing this service from the product in future releases. Successful exploitation of this issue could result in remote code execution.

Affected:
- VMware / NSX SD-WAN by VeloCloud: affected prior to version 3.1.0
